props.text: Ten days in the Pacific Northwest
Rain forest, wild beaches, the Columbia River Gorge and a volcano, in one loop from Seattle. Tap a day to find it on the map.
Pike Place Market, the waterfront and the Space Needle at dusk.
2.5 h with the ferry · overnight in Port Angeles
Take the Edmonds ferry, then drive up to Hurricane Ridge for mountain views.
Walk the Hall of Mosses under moss-draped maples; stop at Lake Crescent on the way.
Sea stacks, driftwood and tide pools at Ruby Beach and Rialto Beach.
Cross the Columbia at its mouth and climb the Astoria Column.
Haystack Rock at low tide, then the trail at Ecola State Park.
Food carts, Powell's Books and the Japanese Garden.
1 h each way · overnight in Portland
Multnomah Falls and the waterfall corridor; check whether a timed permit is needed.
Wildflower meadows and glacier views on the Skyline Trail at Paradise.
A last morning hike, then return the car in Seattle.
Summer prices for 9 nights, 1 room, one rental car. Treat it as a starting point.

Multnomah Falls may need a timed-use permit in peak season.
Check wildfire closures and air quality the week you leave.
An America the Beautiful pass covers both national parks.
